            print("Database exists but contains no tables.")
            df = pd.DataFrame()
    except Exception as e:

        df = pd.DataFrame()

# Now perform outlier detection if we have data
if not df.empty:
    print("
" + "="*50)
    print("OUTLIER DETECTION ANALYSIS")
    print("="*50)
    
    # Identify numeric columns for outlier detection
    numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
    
    if numeric_cols:
        print(f"
Numeric columns available for outlier detection: {numeric_cols}")
        
        # Method 1: Z-score method (for normally distributed data)
        print("
" + "-"*40)
        print("Z-SCORE OUTLIER DETECTION")
        print("-"*40)
        
        for col in numeric_cols:
            if df[col].notna().sum() > 0:  # Check if column has non-null values
                # Calculate Z-scores
                z_scores = np.abs((df[col] - df[col].mean()) / df[col].std())
                
                # Identify outliers (typically |Z| > 3)
                outliers_z = df[z_scores > 3]
                
                print(f"
Column: {col}")
                print(f"  Mean: {df[col].mean():.2f}, Std: {df[col].std():.2f}")
                print(f"  Number of Z-score outliers (|Z| > 3): {len(outliers_z)}")
                
                if len(outliers_z) > 0:
                    print(f"  Outlier values: {outliers_z[col].values[:10]}")  # Show first 10
                    print(f"  Outlier indices: {outliers_z.index.tolist()[:10]}")  # Show first 10
        
        # Method 2: IQR method (more robust to non-normal distributions)
        print("
" + "-"*40)
        print("IQR (INTERQUARTILE RANGE) OUTLIER DETECTION")
        print("-"*40)
        
        for col in numeric_cols:
            if df[col].notna().sum() > 0:
                # Calculate quartiles
                Q1 = df[col].quantile(0.25)
                Q3 = df[col].quantile(0.75)
                IQR = Q3 - Q1
                
                # Define outlier bounds
                lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
                upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
                
                # Identify outliers
                outliers_iqr = df[(df[col] < lower_bound) | (df[col] > upper_bound)]
                
                print(f"
Column: {col}")
                print(f"  Q1: {Q1:.2f}, Q3: {Q3:.2f}, IQR: {IQR:.2f}")
                print(f"  Lower bound: {lower_bound:.2f}, Upper bound: {upper_bound:.2f}")
                print(f"  Number of IQR outliers: {len(outliers_iqr)}")
                
                if len(outliers_iqr) > 0:
                    print(f"  Outlier values: {outliers_iqr[col].values[:10]}")  # Show first 10
                    print(f"  Outlier indices: {outliers_iqr.index.tolist()[:10]}")  # Show first 10
        
        # Create a summary DataFrame of outliers
        print("
" + "-"*40)
        print("OUTLIER SUMMARY")
        print("-"*40)
        
        outlier_summary = []
        for col in numeric_cols:
            if df[col].notna().sum() > 0:
                # Z-score outliers
                z_scores = np.abs((df[col] - df[col].mean()) / df[col].std())
                z_outliers = df[z_scores > 3]
                
                # IQR outliers
                Q1 = df[col].quantile(0.25)
                Q3 = df[col].quantile(0.75)
                IQR = Q3 - Q1
                iqr_outliers = df[(df[col] < Q1 - 1.5 * IQR) | (df[col] > Q3 + 1.5 * IQR)]
                
                outlier_summary.append({
                    'column': col,
                    'z_score_outliers': len(z_outliers),
                    'iqr_outliers': len(iqr_outliers),
                    'total_rows': len(df),
                    'outlier_percentage_z': f"{(len(z_outliers)/len(df)*100):.1f}%",
                    'outlier_percentage_iqr': f"{(len(iqr_outliers)/len(df)*100):.1f}%"
                })
        
        summary_df = pd.DataFrame(outlier_summary)
        print("
Outlier detection summary:")
        print(summary_df.to_string(index=False))
        
        # Visualize outliers for the first numeric column (if any)
        if len(numeric_cols) > 0:
            import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
            
            first_numeric_col = numeric_cols[0]
            print(f"
Visualizing outliers for column: {first_numeric_col}")
            
            fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
            
            # Box plot
            df.boxplot(column=first_numeric_col, ax=axes[0])
            axes[0].set_title(f'Box Plot of {first_numeric_col}')
            axes[0].set_ylabel(first_numeric_col)
            
            # Histogram with outlier markers
            axes[1].hist(df[first_numeric_col], bins=30, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
            
            # Mark outliers using IQR method
            Q1 = df[first_numeric_col].quantile(0.25)
            Q3 = df[first_numeric_col].quantile(0.75)
            IQR = Q3 - Q1
            lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
            upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
            
            outliers = df[(df[first_numeric_col] < lower_bound) | (df[first_numeric_col] > upper_bound)]
            
            if len(outliers) > 0:
                axes[1].axvline(x=lower_bound, color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, label='Lower bound')
                axes[1].axvline(x=upper_bound, color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7, label='Upper bound')
                axes[1].legend()
            
            axes[1].set_title(f'Histogram of {first_numeric_col} with Outlier Bounds')
            axes[1].set_xlabel(first_numeric_col)
            axes[1].set_ylabel('Frequency')
            
            plt.tight_layout()
            plt.show()
    else:
        print("No numeric columns found for outlier detection.")
